acceptance_policy.camera_deadline_gate: deadline from image availability to reception of the last of 30 frames; incomplete images count as misses

drop_reconciliation.timestamped_scope: droppedPacketLengthsQueueOverflow vector, independently split into measurement and drain after warm-up
drop_reconciliation.whole_run_scope: TrafficAudit queue packetDropped callbacks from t=0 through simulation end

queue_trace_recalculation.method: independent streaming recomputation from retained right-continuous queue occupancy change points

run_report.queueing_time_scope: whole simulation; includes warm-up and drain

tas_gate_schedule.note: Gate-state vectors are expected only for scheduled TAS gates. Permanently open SP brake exits have empty schedules and are verified from effective SCA configuration; no transition vector is expected.

sync_audit_authoritative.continuous_conformity: not_verified; 1 ms periodic samples and discrete clock-signal snapshots do not cover every instant
sync_audit_authoritative.definition: offset_i = corrected_clock_i_raw - corrected_HPC_raw at the same probe event
sync_audit_authoritative.method: simultaneous corrected IClock::getClockTime() snapshots; integer native ticks subtracted before serialization; no interpolation

positions.notes: Reused and audited by frozen manifest; native-tick sync summary is authoritative.

acceptance_policy.camera_deadline_gate: deadline from image availability to reception of the last of 30 frames; incomplete images count as misses
acceptance_policy.noncamera_deadline_gate: per-packet latency from CreationTimeTag to receiver; packet losses count as misses

credit_vector_validation.sample_source: streamed .vec samples to pilot_other_vectors.csv.gz in original ticks/credit units

drop_reconciliation.limitation: drops.csv stores whole-run aggregates and first/last timestamps, not a warm-up-binned count; the scope delta is not silently called a measurement loss
drop_reconciliation.sca_scope: droppedPacketsQueueOverflow count with OMNeT++ automatic warm-up filtering; t>=warmup through drain
drop_reconciliation.timestamped_scope: droppedPacketLengthsQueueOverflow vector, independently split into measurement and drain after warm-up
drop_reconciliation.whole_run_scope: TrafficAudit queue packetDropped callbacks from t=0 through simulation end

run_report.queueing_time_scope: whole simulation; includes warm-up and drain

synchronization_native_tick_audit.definition: offset_i = corrected_clock_i_raw - corrected_HPC_raw at the same probe event
synchronization_native_tick_audit.method: simultaneous corrected IClock::getClockTime() snapshots; integer native ticks subtracted before serialization; no interpolation

tas_gate_schedule.note: Gate-state vectors are expected only for scheduled TAS gates. Permanently open SP brake exits have empty schedules and are verified from effective SCA configuration; no transition vector is expected.

sync_audit_authoritative.continuous_conformity: not_verified; 1 ms periodic samples and discrete clock-signal snapshots do not cover every instant
sync_audit_authoritative.definition: offset_i = corrected_clock_i_raw - corrected_HPC_raw at the same probe event

positions.notes: Reused and audited by frozen manifest; native-tick sync summary is authoritative.

acceptance_policy.camera_deadline_gate: deadline from image availability to reception of the last of 30 frames; incomplete images count as misses
acceptance_policy.noncamera_deadline_gate: per-packet latency from CreationTimeTag to receiver; packet losses count as misses

credit_vector_validation.sample_source: streamed .vec samples to pilot_other_vectors.csv.gz in original ticks/credit units

drop_reconciliation.timestamped_scope: droppedPacketLengthsQueueOverflow vector, independently split into measurement and drain after warm-up
drop_reconciliation.whole_run_scope: TrafficAudit queue packetDropped callbacks from t=0 through simulation end

queue_trace_recalculation.method: independent streaming recomputation from retained right-continuous queue occupancy change points

run_report.queueing_time_scope: whole simulation; includes warm-up and drain

tas_gate_schedule.note: Gate-state vectors are expected only for scheduled TAS gates. Permanently open SP brake exits have empty schedules and are verified from effective SCA configuration; no transition vector is expected.

sync_audit_authoritative.continuous_conformity: not_verified; 1 ms periodic samples and discrete clock-signal snapshots do not cover every instant
sync_audit_authoritative.definition: offset_i = corrected_clock_i_raw - corrected_HPC_raw at the same probe event
sync_audit_authoritative.method: simultaneous corrected IClock::getClockTime() snapshots; integer native ticks subtracted before serialization; no interpolation

positions.notes: Reused and audited by frozen manifest; native-tick sync summary is authoritative.

acceptance_policy.camera_deadline_gate: deadline from image availability to reception of the last of 30 frames; incomplete images count as misses
acceptance_policy.noncamera_deadline_gate: per-packet latency from CreationTimeTag to receiver; packet losses count as misses

credit_vector_validation.sample_source: streamed .vec samples to pilot_other_vectors.csv.gz in original ticks/credit units

drop_reconciliation.limitation: drops.csv stores whole-run aggregates and first/last timestamps, not a warm-up-binned count; the scope delta is not silently called a measurement loss
drop_reconciliation.sca_scope: droppedPacketsQueueOverflow count with OMNeT++ automatic warm-up filtering; t>=warmup through drain
drop_reconciliation.timestamped_scope: droppedPacketLengthsQueueOverflow vector, independently split into measurement and drain after warm-up
drop_reconciliation.whole_run_scope: TrafficAudit queue packetDropped callbacks from t=0 through simulation end

sync_audit_authoritative.continuous_conformity: not_verified; 1 ms periodic samples and discrete clock-signal snapshots do not cover every instant
sync_audit_authoritative.definition: offset_i = corrected_clock_i_raw - corrected_HPC_raw at the same probe event
sync_audit_authoritative.method: simultaneous corrected IClock::getClockTime() snapshots; integer native ticks subtracted before serialization; no interpolation

positions.notes: Reused and audited by frozen manifest; native-tick sync summary is authoritative.

acceptance_policy.camera_deadline_gate: deadline from image availability to reception of the last of 30 frames; incomplete images count as misses

queue_trace_recalculation.method: independent streaming recomputation from retained right-continuous queue occupancy change points

run_report.queueing_time_scope: whole simulation; includes warm-up and drain

tas_gate_schedule.note: Gate-state vectors are expected only for scheduled TAS gates. Permanently open SP brake exits have empty schedules and are verified from effective SCA configuration; no transition vector is expected.

sync_audit_authoritative.continuous_conformity: not_verified; 1 ms periodic samples and discrete clock-signal snapshots do not cover every instant
sync_audit_authoritative.definition: offset_i = corrected_clock_i_raw - corrected_HPC_raw at the same probe event
sync_audit_authoritative.method: simultaneous corrected IClock::getClockTime() snapshots; integer native ticks subtracted before serialization; no interpolation

positions.notes: Reused and audited by frozen manifest; native-tick sync summary is authoritative.

acceptance_policy.camera_deadline_gate: deadline from image availability to reception of the last of 30 frames; incomplete images count as misses
acceptance_policy.noncamera_deadline_gate: per-packet latency from CreationTimeTag to receiver; packet losses count as misses

credit_vector_validation.sample_source: streamed .vec samples to pilot_other_vectors.csv.gz in original ticks/credit units

drop_reconciliation.limitation: drops.csv stores whole-run aggregates and first/last timestamps, not a warm-up-binned count; the scope delta is not silently called a measurement loss
drop_reconciliation.sca_scope: droppedPacketsQueueOverflow count with OMNeT++ automatic warm-up filtering; t>=warmup through drain
drop_reconciliation.timestamped_scope: droppedPacketLengthsQueueOverflow vector, independently split into measurement and drain after warm-up
drop_reconciliation.whole_run_scope: TrafficAudit queue packetDropped callbacks from t=0 through simulation end

run_report.queueing_time_scope: whole simulation; includes warm-up and drain

tas_gate_schedule.note: Gate-state vectors are expected only for scheduled TAS gates. Permanently open SP brake exits have empty schedules and are verified from effective SCA configuration; no transition vector is expected.

separate_existing_C3_sync_controls.profile_identity: load-specific official C3, independently matched by plan/profile hash

acceptance_policy.camera_deadline_gate: deadline from image availability to reception of the last of 30 frames; incomplete images count as misses
acceptance_policy.noncamera_deadline_gate: per-packet latency from CreationTimeTag to receiver; packet losses count as misses

credit_vector_validation.sample_source: streamed .vec samples to pilot_other_vectors.csv.gz in original ticks/credit units

drop_reconciliation.timestamped_scope: droppedPacketLengthsQueueOverflow vector, independently split into measurement and drain after warm-up
drop_reconciliation.whole_run_scope: TrafficAudit queue packetDropped callbacks from t=0 through simulation end
